annotations.text:
Ten sections, S01 to S10.

The dashed strip at the top of each one is a review layer, not part of the page — switch "Show eeat" off above this artboard to see the production design.

Dashed cards and grey text are deliberate gaps waiting on the clinic, not unfinished work.

Which pillar each section carries, and how much of it the clinic can actually evidence today.

Two rows are blocked: the MBBS / MD credential conflict, and the Sector 39 vs Chandwal Murdawan address conflict. Both need a decision from the clinic before this page ships.

The trust-critical path at 390px: who treats you, where to verify it, the safety protocols, the byline, the address.

Sticky WhatsApp + Book bar at the bottom, 52px targets throughout.
